D/ IMP TITVS CAES VESPASIAN AVG PM ; R/ TRP IX IMP [?XV] COS VIII PP

Silver coin. Denarius of Titus (79-81), mint of Rome, issue of 79-80, RIC vol. 2 page 119 no. 22a. Obverse description: Craggy bullnecked bust laureate right. Legend retrograde. Obverse inscription: IMP TITVS CAES VESPASIAN AVG PM. Reverse description: Elephant walking left, row of smeared dots above its back. Legend normal. Reverse inscription: TRP IX IMP [?XV] COS VIII PP. Diameter: 18.7mm, Weight: 2.81gms, die axis: 6
